notes: Outfeed and G3: MOVE_OUTFEED v2.0 with G3SNAP / G3REST - the outfeed axis reports its pre-outfeed position again after shuttling a part out, without moving and without a per-machine constant. Operator stage popups are level-triggered, so a missed or dismissed prompt comes back instead of stranding the robot, and the magnet hold can no longer fire while the conveyors are jogged by hand. Nest windows centre on the features they hold rather than the window box, so a lone hole sits on X=0. UF1 readout comes off the solved frames - no KAREL needed. Cycle Start is gated on NC3's own measured length. PROGRAM panel shows the row being cut in yellow and finished rows in green. Import Check: Trim faces and Extend faces restored, a Radius measure for fillets and holes, measure readouts in two rows. Settings closes without re-staging the 3D view. Slip log capped with a per-run marker. NOTE: the robot programs MOVE_OUTFEED, G3SNAP and G3REST must be loaded on the controller separately.
